rv.q: Duke Theseus becomes MP for Chichester, a seat held by the Conservatives for a century from 1924. With one character wearing Major rosettes on her breasts, a PM often derided as dull is becoming a theatre star: the National next year stages a James Graham bio-drama, Major.

A local group of Young Conservatives rehearse a play to celebrate the upcoming nuptials, not running as smoothly as they would like due to the overzealous nature of their newest member, Bottom ( Munya Chawawa ). But not everyone is happy with their love life, as four young lovers argue with their elders as to whom they want to be with.

Her lover, Lysander, is played by Ellie Larkin who is unmistakably feminine. As a sharp contrast to the Conservative Party heartland of the senior mortals, the Downs are revealed to be frenzied and Dionysian in a set by Joanna Scotcher that pulsates with Britpop, skateboarding, and grunge styling.
